reuse.why: The new action reuses the existing category predicate, category loader, spending conversion, sheet access, batching, budget writer, and undo wrappers.

duplication.why: Eligibility and spending conversion remain shared, although setZero adds a near-copy of the category-loading query with a different group join.

placement.why: Budget policy and orchestration remain in actions.ts, method registration remains in app.ts, and tag parsing uses the shared tags module.

scope.why: The edits address the requested month-wide actions, their tests, method registration, and release notes without unrelated changes.

maintainability.why: A single predicate owns the exclusions and all month-wide callers pass the same options, though repeated query shapes and the now broader use of getAverageCategories leave minor maintenance friction.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All affected month-wide actions use isMonthWideCategory, and the new action uses spendingToBudgetAmount and the existing budget-writing infrastructure.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated category-loading SQL is explicit; renaming averageToBudgetAmount broadens a shared helper rather than disguising a copy.

abstraction_drift.where: isMonthWideCategory retains its existing hidden-category option under a new name and centralizes the additional exclusions without caller-specific exceptions or bypasses.
